name: autosense
description: AutoSense AI: web app (React frontend + Express API) for the J26 vehicle service centre system

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
